security_privacy_cost_impact: Test isolation only: the three test files no longer let the operator's global or system git configuration (a core.hooksPath, init.templateDir or any other setting) act in the repositories they make. No credential, personal data, customer data, provider call, CI file, RFC, script or contract.
compatibility_impact: No contract or script changes. The three test files' cases no longer see settings from the operator's HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME or system gitconfig; every repository they make sets what it needs in its own .git/config.
known_limitations: The system gitconfig is not planted by the new cases (that would write outside the test's own directories); GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 is set in the same lines as GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL.
